theme: 个股·行情多时间窗口与聚合：格力电器月度涨跌幅/日均成交额/单日最强涨幅，海康威视年内涨幅与月成交量

initial.question: 格力电器2026年8月单月跌了多少？给我8月的月度涨跌幅。
initial.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND((cur.TCLOSE/prev.TCLOSE-1)*100,4) AS chg_pct FROM (SELECT TCLOSE FROM STK_MKT WHERE SECCODE='000651' AND TRADEDATE BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' ORDER BY TRADEDATE DESC LIMIT 1) cur,(SELECT TCLOSE FROM STK_MKT WHERE SECCODE='000651' AND TRADEDATE BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31' ORDER BY TRADEDATE DESC LIMIT 1) prev

feedbacks.question: 那7月呢？是涨还是跌，幅度多少？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND((cur.TCLOSE/prev.TCLOSE-1)*100,4) AS chg_pct FROM (SELECT TCLOSE FROM STK_MKT WHERE SECCODE='000651' AND TRADEDATE BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31' ORDER BY TRADEDATE DESC LIMIT 1) cur,(SELECT TCLOSE FROM STK_MKT WHERE SECCODE='000651' AND TRADEDATE BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30' ORDER BY TRADEDATE DESC LIMIT 1) prev

feedbacks.question: 8月它平均每天的成交额有多少？
feedbacks.gold_display: 约18.91亿元/日（8月共21个交易日，全月成交397.14亿元）
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(TVALUE) FROM STK_MKT WHERE SECCODE='000651' AND TRADEDATE BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'

feedbacks.question: 8月里单日涨幅最大的是哪一天？那天涨了多少？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT TRADEDATE,CHNG_PCT FROM STK_MKT WHERE SECCODE='000651' AND TRADEDATE BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' ORDER BY CHNG_PCT DESC LIMIT 1

feedbacks.question: 换个票，海康威视今年以来累计涨了多少？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT a.CHNG_PCT_YEAR_SOFAR FROM ANA_STK_EXPR_IDX a JOIN GET_A_SEC_CODE g ON a.INNER_CODE=g.INNER_CODE WHERE g.SEC_CODE='002415' ORDER BY a.ENDDATE DESC LIMIT 1

feedbacks.question: 它8月整月下来总共成交了多少股？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(TVOLUME) FROM STK_MKT WHERE SECCODE='002415' AND TRADEDATE BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
